prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” HVAC company for every Houston homeowner — the best choice depends on your location in the metro area, whether it’s residential or commercial, the problem (simple repair vs system replacement), your budget, and whether you need emergency service. That said, some companies consistently get high marks in Houston and are worth checking first:

- John Moore Services — long-established Houston company with strong local reputation and broad services.  
- Baker Brothers Plumbing, AC & Electric — well-known locally for fast response and good customer reviews.  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (Houston) — national company with a large local footprint and 24/7 service.  
- One Hour Heating & Air / Benjamin Franklin (local franchisees) — often rated well for punctuality and guarantees.

How to pick the best one for you
- Check licensing & insurance (ask for contractor license and proof of insurance).  
- Look for NATE-certified technicians and manufacturer certifications for your system.  
- Read recent Google/Yelp/BBB reviews and look for patterns (speed, honesty, follow-up).  
- Ask about diagnostic fees, parts & labor warranties, and emergency/after-hours charges.  
- Get 2–3 written estimates and compare scope of work, not just price.  
- Ask about financing or maintenance plans if you want longer-term value.

If you want, tell me your zip code, whether it’s a home or business, and whether it’s an emergency — I can pull up 3–5 top-rated local AC repair companies and show recent review summaries and contact options.
